question: How can a participant react on the shared item assignment?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour How Participant Can React On Item Assignments
youtubeLink.description: This video explains how a participant can react on shared item assignments

sections.beforeHtml: A participant reacts on assigned shared items directly in the Shared items list. The reaction controls only appear when the current participant is the assigned person for that row.
items: Open Trip > Shared items for the selected trip.
Find a row assigned to you. Plantour shows Accepted and Rejected checkboxes only on rows you are allowed to react to.
Click Accepted if you agree to take responsibility for that item. Plantour then creates a personal trip item for you from that shared item.
Click Rejected if you do not want to take responsibility for that item. Plantour marks the assignment as rejected.
If you uncheck Accepted, Plantour removes the personal accepted item that was created for you.
If you reject an item that you had already accepted, Plantour clears the accepted link and removes the personal accepted item from your trip items.
Plantour notifies the admin when you accept or reject the assignment.
sections.afterHtml: Accepting is the bridge from the shared-planning page to your own personal work page. After acceptance, continue with What can a participant do after accepting the item assignment?.
